messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-ingest-prod — usage emits delayed (lag > 10m) + token-count variance across partitions > 6% (auto-alert). Root cause candidate: downstream queue congestion. Please triage. thread:1769876543

jordan (oncall): ack, I'm on it. Looking at alerts now.

ash (sre): on call — I can see backpressure on usage-proxy -> kafka-ingest. Consumer lag spiked ~10:07 UTC. Metric: consumer_lag(topic=usage-events)=~42000.

paul (billing): seeing multiple customers flagged with temporary overage flags in the billing service. Flags started at 10:05 UTC. Some users see "potential overage" emails. Which pipeline is the source for token counting?

ash (sre): token counting happens in usage-aggregator after kafka ingest. If messages are delayed the aggregator can double-count during replays. Need to check ingestion offsets and dedupe window.

jordan (oncall): quick customer-impact check: @tanya can you pull a list of customers who got overage emails (10:00-10:15)? we should hold outbound emails if it's noisy.

custops-bot (automated): Query run: 32 customers with overage-alert emails shipped between 10:03-10:12 UTC. Sample IDs: CUST-129, CUST-781, CUST-442.

tanya (custops): thanks. I'll mute outbound email notifications at the smtp-router level (temp) and open a support banner if needed. Notifying SRE + Billing.

ash (sre): mitigation plan: 1) pause billing flag emitter 2) restart usage-proxy to clear stuck connections 3) run dedupe/replay check and backfill reconciler. I'll try a safe restart of usage-proxy in staging-like manner (canary restart to avoid compounding).

sam (eng-lead): +1. Also recommend toggling rate-limit enforcement off for a 15m window so we don't cascade cascades. We'll need an owner for manual reconciliation. Paul?

paul (billing): I can own reconciliation. Steps we need: a) mark emitted overage flags as suppressed for the window and create manual billing tickets if final counts after backfill exceed thresholds. b) run backfill script that recalculates token counts from raw events. c) re-run billing delta job and reconcile customers.

jordan (oncall): ash — share exact commands you plan for restart and the backfill job so we can run in off-peak.

ash (sre): restart plan (will canary two pods then scale up):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/usage-proxy --selector=canary=false
# monitor consumer lag
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=usage-proxy -w
```
Backfill trigger (run from ops jumpbox):
```
./tools/run_backfill --start 2026-03-15T09:55:00Z --end 2026-03-15T10:20:00Z --dry-run=false --write-mode=upsert --task=token_reconcile
```
SQL to suppress emitted overage flags (one-time patch):
```
UPDATE billing.overage_flags
SET suppressed = true, suppressed_by = 'incident-1769876543', suppressed_note = 'auto-suppressed during ingest-lag investigation'
WHERE emitted_at >= '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z' AND emitted_at <= '2026-03-15T10:20:00Z' AND source = 'auto-emitter';
```

jordan (oncall): deployed the suppression update to staging DB. Paul, confirm that suppressed flags won't block later reconciliation?

paul (billing): confirmed — suppressed flags are excluded from automatic invoicing and will be surfaced to manual tickets. Good to go.

deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment usage-proxy (canary pods first): deployment/usage-proxy restarted by ash at 2026-03-15T10:12:07Z.

ash (sre): restart successful for canary. consumer_lag decreased from 42000 -> 18000 within 3 minutes. rolling restart continuing.

ash (sre): logs snippet from usage-proxy at 10:11:23:```
WARN [ingest] downstream write timeout (retrying) partition=42 offset=980234
ERROR [conn] long-poll: client=10.2.5.17 socket-timeout
```

jordan (oncall): good. I've disabled outbound overage emails via smtp-router toggle. Custops to send a follow-up later if needed.

tanya (custops): banner drafted. waiting for final confirmation from Billing before any external comms.

paul (billing): starting backfill run now (kick off). I'll report progress to thread.

paul (billing): backfill job progress: 0% -> 12% in 4m. Running dedupe on event keys (request_id + user_id). If dedupe success then final counts should converge to pre-incident numbers.

ash (sre): additional precaution: enable short-term strict dedupe window in aggregator config so duplicates within 10m are ignored. Patch applied via configmap and aggregator pods reloaded:```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/usage-aggregator DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECONDS=600
```

paul (billing): backfill job completed at 10:41 UTC. Recalc shows token counts for impacted window were 4.3% lower than emitted counts (meaning some duplicates caused apparent higher counts in emitter). We'll run reconciliation script and un-suppress any legitimately over-threshold flags after manual review.

paul (billing): reconciliation summary: of 32 customers flagged, 27 are false positives due to duplicate emits. 5 customers have legitimate overage after recalculation; manual invoices/tickets will be created.

tanya (custops): will prepare email templates for the 27 false positives: apology + "no action required". Also prepping escalation comms for the 5 with true overages.

jordan (oncall): incident status: mitigated — ingestion pipeline restart reduced lag, backfill completed, suppression prevented noisy emails. Postmortem owner: sam (eng-lead). Please create a postmortem doc with timeline, root cause, and follow-ups.

sam (eng-lead): creating PM doc now. Initial follow-ups I want: 1) improve consumer autoscaling thresholds, 2) add end-to-end test for dedupe regressions, 3) harden emitter to handle replay idempotency, 4) post-incident customer comms runbook.

paul (billing): creating manual tickets for the 5 affected customers and flagging for credit review.

incidents-bot: Incident annotated as "mitigated" by jordan at 2026-03-15T10:47:10Z. Severity: Sev3 -> customer-impact (emails sent) -> mitigated (suppressed + replay fix).

jordan (oncall): thanks team. We should keep monitoring token-count variance for next 24h and schedule a follow-up run with infra/eng to review the dedupe window logic.

ash (sre): tailing metrics now, will call if anything reappears.

paul (billing): I'll publish a billing reconciliation summary in the billing repo and link it to the PM doc.

tanya (custops): will wait to send final comms until PM review.

sam (eng-lead): PM doc created: /docs/incidents/1769876543-token-emit-glitch-postmortem.md — team, add any missing notes. Closing thread when PM + billing summary are complete. :white_check_mark:
